title: John McCarthy's 'Bureau of Simulation' story
summary: Jacques Vallee tells of John McCarthy's 'Bureau of Simulation' story, about 1968 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and then one day you're going to get a letter from the Bureau of simulation the Bureau of simulation says Dear Sir

plain: A researcher named Jacques Vallee, on Jesse Michels's podcast, recalls a story told by John McCarthy, a computer scientist at Stanford's artificial intelligence lab, around 1968. Vallee says McCarthy described a day when you would get a letter from the "Bureau of Simulation" that begins "Dear Sir," a playful way of raising the idea that our world could be a simulation run by someone else.
